site.name: Muhammad Umer Mujtaba
site.description: Portfolio of Muhammad Umer Mujtaba, a software engineer specializing in React Native, Flutter, and Next.js. Builder of cross-platform apps with real-time integrations, shipped on the Play Store.

hero.headline: One codebase, shipped to iOS, Android, and the web.
hero.supporting: I'm Muhammad Umer Mujtaba, a software engineer who builds cross-platform products end to end — architecture, state management, and the real-time integrations that hold them together.

paragraphs: I work at the intersection of mobile and web, building products in React Native, Flutter, and Next.js that need to feel native on every platform they touch. Most of my time goes into the parts users never see directly: state architecture, monorepo structure, and the real-time plumbing — Firebase, Agora, HealthKit — that makes an app feel alive.

At Nextek Solutions, I've owned full feature lifecycles across three shipping products: a fitness and community platform synced across iOS, Android, and web from a single codebase; an audio-storytelling app live on the Play Store; and a media discovery app built around large, fast-scrolling catalogs.

I care most about the handoff points — where a phone talks to a wearable, a client talks to Firestore, or a mobile app shares logic with its web counterpart — because that's where products either feel seamless or fall apart.

experience.summary: Shipping cross-platform products across iOS, Android, and web — fitness, storytelling, and media discovery.
Delivered React.js web modules in a remote internship, meeting sprint deadlines and strengthening component-based architecture.

projects.name: Buzzmi
projects.tagline: Fitness & community platform shared across iOS, Android, and web
bullets: Architected a monorepo sharing business logic across React Native and Next.js, cutting duplicated code by ~40% and enabling simultaneous releases across 3 platforms.
Built social authentication (Google, Apple, Facebook) and in-app purchase flows integrated with Airbridge deep linking to reduce onboarding drop-off.
Unified fitness tracking across HealthKit and Health Connect for real-time smartwatch sync.
Built a community platform with programs, workouts, habit tracking, a social feed, in-app chat, and role-based access for coaches vs. users.

projects.name: Storybirds
projects.tagline: Audio-storytelling platform connecting adults and children through voice
bullets: Launched an audio-storytelling app, live on the Play Store, connecting adults and children through asynchronous voice recordings.
Engineered background-capable audio playback with secure recording, removing interruptions that caused drop-off.
Built a Firebase FCM push notification system alerting users to new story posts, driving increased daily session opens.
Optimized media upload/download pipelines with chunked transfers, progress indicators, and automatic retry logic for low-bandwidth connections.

projects.name: Photo Play
projects.tagline: Movie discovery app with Netflix-inspired browsing
bullets: Integrated REST APIs to power responsive, top-rated movie listing feeds.
Designed a Netflix-inspired UI with custom carousels, hero banners, and animated transitions.
Implemented list virtualization and image caching to support large media catalogs without performance loss.

apps.name: Fit Hunt
apps.tagline: Final-year fitness & nutrition app — 2nd place among FYP submissions
bullets: Tailored diet plans, exercise libraries, and daily progress tracking.
Firebase Auth and Firestore persisting goals, dietary logs, and workout history.

apps.name: Kiddu
apps.tagline: Educational app for kids across 6 interactive learning modules
bullets: 6 modules: alphabets, numbers, animals, shapes, games, and pronunciation guides.
Firebase auth, a rewards system, and premium content gating by user role.
Reusable atomic component library with Lottie animation and audio handling.

apps.name: Food Ordering App
apps.tagline: Full-cycle ordering experience with live in-app voice support
bullets: Checkout flow with cart management, item customization, and automated order-confirmation emails.
Agora real-time calling for in-app voice communication.
Category browsing with real-time search, filtering, and personalized recommendations.
